statusLine.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$input = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; $dir = $input.workspace.current_dir; $model = $input.model.display_name; $outputStyle = $input.output_style.name; $branch = ''; try { $branch = git -C $dir rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>$null; if ($branch) { $branch = " [$branch]" } } catch {}; Write-Output (\"$model |$outputStyle| $dir$branch\")"
